title: Rapier: a pick striking a string, stability against the time step
question: A string modelled as a chain of small bodies joined by spherical joints, anchored at the nut and the bridge, and a kinematic pick crossing it at 2 m/s: at which time steps does the pick pass through without contact, and how far does the chain stretch?
hypothesis: Without continuous collision detection a 1 mm pick moving 33 mm per step at 1/60 s passes through a 0.5 mm string; CCD on the pick prevents it at every step; the joint error shrinks as the step shrinks.

predictions.metric: pick passes through without contact, CCD off
predictions.predicted: yes at 1/30 and 1/60 s, no at 1/480 s

predictions.metric: pick passes through without contact, CCD on
largest relative stretch of the chain, 1/240 s
largest relative stretch of the chain, 1/30 s

predictions.predicted: proportional to the steps per second, within 30%
